results.note: the broker: every binary message this server receives (after its TLS, which requires a client certificate issued by its tlsMutualAuthenticationCertificateChain, a private CA, and names that CA in its CertificateRequest) but a lone zero byte is answered with an MQTT CONNACK, so a load connects exactly when the client presents a certificate the server accepts
